provider_mass.title: Music Assistant
provider_mass.intro: Your own music library in Music Assistant, with what it brings together from your services. Playing it also needs the Music Assistant playback plugin.
provider_mass.url: Address of the Music Assistant server
provider_mass.url.hint: Such as http://192.168.1.100:8095. Without it nothing is searched there.
provider_mass.token.hint: Music Assistant 2.11 and later want one: make it in Music Assistant under Settings, Users.
